overloadMerges.note: offset is documented '<->' in the parameter table (input: starting offset to write at; output: incremented by the number of bytes written, so it can be reused for a subsequent write); autoparse defaulted it to direction:in.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to write into the BLOB

params.name: textFormat
params.description: Format and character set of text; defaults to Mac C string if omitted

params.name: offset
params.description: In: offset within the BLOB (in bytes) at which to write, overwriting existing content there. Out: updated to the offset just past the written text, for reuse in a subsequent write. If omitted (and * also omitted), the text is written at the start of the BLOB, overwriting prior contents.

If passed, the text is appended to the end of the BLOB, extending its size accordingly, instead of overwriting at an offset.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Writes text into the BLOB at a given (or default zero) offset, overwriting existing content there, and returns the post-write offset via the offset variable for chained writes.

discriminatedBy.rule: Used when the caller needs to track/reuse the write position (offset variable form); mutually exclusive with the trailing '*' append-flag overload.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Appends text to the end of the BLOB when '*' is passed, or overwrites from the start of the BLOB when both trailing optional parameters are omitted.

discriminatedBy.rule: Used when the caller wants simple append-or-overwrite-at-start behavior via the '*' flag, without tracking an offset.

constraints: Since this command alters the BLOB passed as a parameter, it does not support blob objects (4D.Blob type); only legacy BLOB variables/fields.
New bytes allocated in the BLOB beyond what is written (e.g. when writing past the current end) are initialized to zero.
